items.name: competitor-intel-monitor
items.title: Competitor Intel Monitor
items.description: Scheduled competitor URL monitor that diffs pages and delivers scored Slack or email digests.
items.author: TommyBez

overview: Competitor Intel Monitor is a scheduled eve agent that re-reads a list of competitor pages you already chose. On each cron tick it checks robots.txt, pulls the HTML that is allowed, and compares normalized text to the last snapshot in a JSON file or Upstash Redis. You configure the list and thresholds once, then leave it running.

You interact with it through environment variables and your inbox or Slack. Set COMPETITOR_INTEL_URLS or a JSON or text file, pick Slack, Resend, or both, and trigger watch-competitor-pages. The agent previews every digest and only sends when confirmSend is true and a date-derived idempotency key is present.

It is useful when you want a quiet baseline plus alerts that ignore tiny edits. First-seen URLs are stored without a ping. Later diffs report a score from changed character weight, and only rows that clear both gates go out. Robots disallows and missing config stop that path instead of inventing a page.
howItWorks: On the watch-competitor-pages schedule (cron from COMPETITOR_INTEL_CRON, default 08:00 UTC), the agent loads the competitor-intel-watch skill and, before any email, the email-best-practices skill.
It calls load_watch_config to read the https URL list, alert gates, store kind, and whether Slack or email is configured, and stops if COMPETITOR_INTEL_URLS or delivery settings are missing.

For each listed URL it calls fetch_competitor_page, which loads that origin's robots.txt with EveCompetitorIntelMonitor/1.0 and skips the page when robots disallows the path or the robots file cannot be reached.

Each successful fetch goes to diff_page_snapshot, which compares normalized text to the stored snapshot, writes the new snapshot, and returns score, changedChars, and clearsThreshold. First-seen URLs are baselines with score 0.

If any row clears both COMPETITOR_INTEL_ALERT_MIN_SCORE and COMPETITOR_INTEL_ALERT_MIN_CHANGED_CHARS, the agent calls preview_digest, then send_digest with confirmSend true and an idempotency key such as competitor-intel-monitor-YYYY-MM-DD.
Seven evals cover the schedule path, robots skips, below-threshold silence, digest preview, send confirmation, missing config, and a failed send that must not be reported as delivered.

useCases.title: Pricing page drift
useCases.body: Point the watch list at two competitor pricing URLs. After the first baseline run, a later seat-price rewrite that clears the score and character gates lands in Slack or email with the excerpt from diff_page_snapshot.

useCases.title: Changelog without the noise
useCases.body: Watch a public changelog. A one-word typo stays under COMPETITOR_INTEL_ALERT_MIN_CHANGED_CHARS and is stored only. A new version notes section that clears both gates is the row that gets previewed.

useCases.title: Robots-respecting research crawl
useCases.body: A competitor blocks /compare in robots.txt. fetch_competitor_page returns blockedByRobots for that path, the agent skips it, and send_digest is never called for an invented compare table.

useCases.title: Team alias on a weekday cron
useCases.body: Set COMPETITOR_INTEL_CRON to weekday mornings and COMPETITOR_INTEL_DIGEST_TO to a team alias. Operators get one Resend HTML mail with the URLs that cleared the gates, not a ping for every tiny HTML shuffle.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_URLS
requirements.body: Comma-separated https URLs to watch. Required unless COMPETITOR_INTEL_URLS_FILE lists at least one https URL. Non-https values are dropped.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_URLS_FILE
requirements.body: Optional JSON object with urls and alert, or a text file with one URL per line. Those URLs are unioned with COMPETITOR_INTEL_URLS.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_CRON
requirements.body: 5-field cron for watch-competitor-pages. Defaults to 0 8 * * * (08:00 UTC on Vercel).

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_ALERT_MIN_SCORE
requirements.body: Minimum score from 0 to 100. Score is round(100 * changedChars / max(beforeLength, afterLength, 1)). Defaults to 25.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_ALERT_MIN_CHANGED_CHARS
requirements.body: Minimum added-plus-removed character weight before a change can clear the gate. Defaults to 40.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_STORE_PATH
requirements.body: JSON snapshot file path. Defaults to .data/competitor-intel-store.json. Use a durable volume if the app filesystem is ephemeral.

requirements.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
requirements.body: Optional Upstash Redis REST URL. When set with UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, snapshots are stored in Redis instead of the file.

requirements.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
requirements.body: Optional Upstash Redis REST token used with UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_USER_AGENT
requirements.body: User-Agent for page and robots.txt fetches. Defaults to EveCompetitorIntelMonitor/1.0.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
requirements.body: Slack incoming webhook. Leave empty to skip Slack. At least one of Slack or a complete email trio is required to send.

requirements.name: RESEND_API_KEY
requirements.body: Resend API key used by send_digest when email recipients are configured. The idempotency key is forwarded to Resend.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_DIGEST_FROM
requirements.body: Verified Resend sender for the HTML digest. Recipients and sender cannot be overridden through tool input.

requirements.name: COMPETITOR_INTEL_DIGEST_TO
requirements.body: Comma-separated recipient addresses. Optional COMPETITOR_INTEL_DIGEST_SUBJECT defaults to Competitor intel digest.

faqs.question: How do I install and run a watch?
faqs.answer: Install with npx shadcn@latest add @evex/competitor-intel-monitor, copy .env.example, set at least one https URL plus Slack or Resend, then POST to /eve/v1/dev/schedules/watch-competitor-pages while iterating.

faqs.question: Will the first run email or Slack me?
faqs.answer: No. diff_page_snapshot stores a first-seen URL as a baseline with score 0 and clearsThreshold false. Only a later run whose score and changedChars both clear the gates can call preview_digest and send_digest.

faqs.question: What if robots.txt blocks a URL?
faqs.answer: fetch_competitor_page returns blockedByRobots and skips the HTTP body. The agent records the skip, does not invent text, and does not send a digest for that URL.

faqs.question: How is the score calculated?
faqs.answer: changedChars is the character weight of words added or removed after HTML is stripped. score is round(100 * changedChars / max(beforeLength, afterLength, 1)), capped at 100. Both that score and minChangedChars must pass.

faqs.question: Can a replayed run send twice?
faqs.answer: send_digest refuses unless confirmSend is true, and it requires a stable idempotency key. Successful sends are cached on that key and the same key is sent to Resend, so a replayed eve step does not duplicate email.
